purpose: Test whether V118 failed because the all-player admitted-work service proxy was only a retrospective complete-assignment veto: retain every frozen V118 certificate and direct native-order alternative construction with the same service choice for every current player.

mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.observed_result: V118 passed four of nine gates. Pulse passed throughput and both QPR conventions; sustained passed both QPR conventions but lost throughput on all three seeds; spike lost both QPR conventions and was fractionally throughput-inferior.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.mechanism_coverage: V118 evaluated 1,806 active windows, compared all 15,368 target players without unavailable evidence, rejected 77 complete alternatives with 205 worse comparisons, and accepted 1,729 alternatives.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.causal_gap: V118 changes only the final certificate. Its alternative is still built by V113: the admitted-work service choice is invoked only for current critical-frontier players, while every noncritical current player is copied from the anchor and can only trigger an after-the-fact veto. The proxy therefore does not guide the placement of most protected players.
mechanism_and_outcome_diagnosis.independent_axis: Change the scope of the existing admitted-work service-directed construction from current critical-frontier players to every current player. Retain the complete V118 all-player Pareto replay as the final certificate.

closed_axes.service_choice_ratio: 9/10 remains bit-for-bit V113 and is applied identically to each eligible current player
closed_axes.admitted_work_definition: pending plus all resident remaining plus same-window projected immutable CPU remains bit-for-bit V113
closed_axes.complete_componentwise_scope: all current players remains bit-for-bit V118
closed_axes.interference_constraints: disabled exactly as V113 and V118
closed_axes.arrival_phase_guard: disabled exactly as V113 and V118

hypothesis.primary: A passive all-player veto cannot improve the noncritical placements whose service it measures. Applying the already-frozen admitted-work service choice to every current player will construct alternatives with direct all-player service improvement, while the complete V118 replay prevents cross-player regressions.
hypothesis.candidate: In the frozen native player order, invoke the exact V113 service choice for every current player using the existing 9/10 ratio and all existing locality, warmness, resource, feasibility, substitution-cap, routed-score, OCS, welfare, and total-service certificates. Then require the complete V118 all-current-player componentwise service Pareto certificate before dispatch.
hypothesis.falsification: The hypothesis fails if the sole candidate does not pass all nine frozen throughput/QPR gates on the complete fresh E926-E928 cohort.

allowed: all immutable and current-state V113 admitted-work, locality, resource, routed-score, OCS, welfare, feasibility, and native-player-order inputs
the frozen 9/10 V113 admitted-work service choice for each current player
the complete V118 per-current-player replay certificate over anchor and alternative
forbidden: completion count, throughput, latency, cost, QPR, SLA outcome, or any completed-request aggregate
future arrivals, future completion, future container state, or future child placement
workload scenario, burst label, seed identity, registered burst interval, or time-to-burst-boundary
any E923-E925 result-derived threshold, margin, ratio, horizon, coefficient, cap, player class, or smoothing width
formal E01-E20 outcome-dependent selection or confirmation outcomes before a training pass
information_boundary.construction_definition: For every current player in frozen native order, call the same deterministic V113 admitted-work service-choice routine that previously applied only to current critical-frontier players. The routine may substitute only under its existing 9/10 service ratio and frozen V113 filters.
information_boundary.componentwise_definition: After construction, for every player in the frozen current-player sequence, alternative_proxy <= anchor_proxy + existing EPSILON. Missing, negative, nonfinite, infeasible, or incomplete evidence rejects the entire alternative.
information_boundary.fail_closed: Any unavailable choice input, incomplete assignment, replay coverage mismatch, replay infeasibility, or failed V113/V118 certificate preserves the exact anchor assignment.

arms.complete_all_player_service_rule: every current player's alternative admitted-work service proxy is no greater than its anchor proxy

candidate_mechanism.only_changed_axis: Invoke the frozen V113 admitted-work service choice for every current player during alternative construction rather than only for current critical-frontier players.
candidate_mechanism.unchanged_final_certificate: Retain the complete V118 all-current-player componentwise service Pareto replay and every V113 certificate.
candidate_mechanism.reference_policy: Policy-independent offline reference construction remains unchanged.
candidate_mechanism.exact_anchor_invariant: Without complete finite choice and replay evidence plus every frozen V113/V118 certificate, dispatch exact V94 for identical state and candidates.

per_window: all frozen V118 causal-arrival, admitted-work, service-choice, score, welfare, assignment-hash, feasibility, and componentwise replay fields
service-directed construction scope, eligible player count, evaluated player count, unavailable player count, substituted player count, and critical/noncritical substitution counts
performance fields retained but not opened before joint blind audit

selection_rule.throughput_gate_per_scenario: candidate three-seed mean is at least the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is nonnegative on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.qpr_gate_per_scenario_per_convention: candidate three-seed mean is strictly greater than the matching V94 anchor mean and candidate-minus-anchor is strictly positive on at least two of three seeds
selection_rule.E3_winner_requires: the sole candidate passes all three metrics in all three E3 scenarios
selection_rule.absolute_formal_n20_baseline_gates: diagnostic only and never used to select the V119 profile
